svg.text: Closed profile of the duct wall: points around the section (a from the inlet).
1. Fabricate as a full 360° ring in 4 rolled segments of S355J2+N
plate 16 mm skin with internal ring and longitudinal stiffeners,
2. Inner surface at the runner (throat) machined after welding to
Ø1978 +2/0 mm, roundness 2 mm, for the 3 mm tip clearance.
3. Leading and trailing edges rounded as the profile; coating per
general note 4; anodes on the outer skin.
Full 360° ring — the model shows a 270° cutaway
TEACHING MODEL — materials, tolerances and wall thicknesses are assumptions. Not for construction.
